title: 第十九章 懂我意思第二十章 施以援手
content_zh:
尽管姜云还不能完全推测出石头的具体用途，但除了提高丹效这一点外，竟然还有能够隐藏修为的能力！
因为当第二天东方博来找姜云的时候，赫然发现姜云的身上竟然没有了丝毫的气息散发出来。
换句话说，他无法看透姜云的真实修为境界了！
如果不是昨天他清楚的知道姜云已经迈入了通脉三重之境，那么现在绝对会认为姜云仍然是个凡人。
这让他不禁感到了新奇，不过正如他先前所说，这是属于姜云的秘密，所以他也没有去打探原因。
不管怎么说，能够隐藏修为，这对姜云来说是一件好事，毕竟他的修炼速度实在是太过惊世骇俗，如果传扬出去，必然会引来有心之人的注意，而石头的这个能力，正好帮了他的大忙。
至于石头的其他用途，因为姜云身边也没有了蕴含道意的物品，所以他也无法再去试验，不过他倒是也琢磨出了一点石头的用法。
石头化水，才能往其中放入丹药，而要想石头化水，则需要吸收道意，而且一两道道意还不够，至少需要三道！
当然，这些都只是姜云的想法，要想证明是否正确，还需要多试验几次。
只不过，以他现在的身份，想要弄到可能蕴含道意的修道物品，也不是一件容易事，所以他只能将石头暂时放到一边，继续专心于自己的修炼。
转眼之间，九天的时间过去，姜云也终于再次终止了自己的修炼，听着肚中响起的“咕噜”声，自言自语的道：“原本辟谷丹可以保证三天不饿，而经过烙印之后，时间延长了三倍！”
“如果在那水中放入引气丹，是否引来的灵气数量，也能达到三倍？”
“另外，听大师兄说，还有不少可以用来提升修为的丹药，如果都能放入水中，都能将丹效提升三倍，那对于我的修炼，可是大有好处！”
姜云的眼中闪过了一道精光，直到此刻，他终于意识到了，这块石头对于自己的修道之路，实在是大有好处，也的确是货真价实的宝贝。
8#4首发l
“真不知道，月柔那小丫头是如何能够断定这石头是宝贝的，不过这么好的东西，给她用应该更合适，爷爷说过她的资质不错，等我回去的时候，就将石头还给她！”
想到姜月柔，姜云的脸上情不自禁的露出了笑容。
转眼之间，自己离开莽山也已经两个多月了，而自己还从来没有和她分开过这么长的时间，恐怕现在这小丫头应该缠着爷爷，打听着自己的下落了！
“我也想家了！”姜云轻轻的叹了口气，强行收回了自己的思念之情，与其在这里想家，倒不如赶紧提升实力，这样就能早点回去！
“只是蕴含道意的物品实在太难找了，尤其以我杂役弟子的身份，根本不可能获得！唯有成为外门弟子之后，每个月宗门才会奖励一些丹药和灵石，并且，还可以通过完成任务，获得贡献点，从而换取各种修道所需的物品。”

这些自然也是东方博告诉姜云的。
宗门虽然是无数人想要拜入的地方，但是修道资源毕竟有限，不可能每个人都能享受到同等待遇，所以对于资源的分发有着近乎苛刻的要求。
甚至就连内门弟子，虽然宗门每个月都会定期发放一些物品，但是要想获得更多的资源，他们也必须完成更多的任务，获得贡献点去自行换取。
而像姜云这样的杂役弟子，也只有在成功拜入宗门的时候会有一次奖赏，也就是三颗辟谷丹和引气丹，以及一本基本功法。
之后宗门就不会再管你，任由你自生自灭，除非你能不断提升修为境界，不断提高自己的实力，在众多弟子之中逐渐的脱颖而出，这样才能得到宗门的关注和重视。
“这样看来，我现在首先要做的，就是成为外门弟子！好在，快了！”
说到这里，姜云的脸上露出了一抹自信的笑容，同时看向了自己的体内，在他的身体之中，赫然已经有着五条经脉畅通无阻！
不到半个月的时间，姜云就从一个凡人跃升到了通脉五重境的修士，而且这还是他刻意压制的结果。
content_en:
Although Jiang Yun could not fully speculate on the specific purpose of the stone, in addition to improving the effectiveness of the elixir, it also had the ability to hide cultivation!
Because when Dongfang Bo came to find Jiang Yun the next day, he was shocked to find that there was no breath coming out of Jiang Yun's body.
In other words, he could no longer see through Jiang Yun's true cultivation level!
If he hadn't clearly known yesterday that Jiang Yun had entered the third level of Tongmai, he would definitely think that Jiang Yun was still a mortal now.
This made him feel novel, but as he said before, this was Jiang Yun's secret, so he did not find out the reason.
In any case, it is a good thing for Jiang Yun to be able to hide his cultivation. After all, his cultivation speed is too shocking. If it is spread, it will definitely attract the attention of interested people, and Shitou's ability is just a big help to him.
As for the other uses of the stone, because Jiang Yun no longer had items containing Taoist meaning around him, he could no longer experiment, but he did figure out some uses for the stone.
Only when the stone turns into water can the elixir be put into it. In order for the stone to turn into water, you need to absorb the Taoist intention, and one or two Taoist intentions are not enough, at least three are needed!
Of course, these are just Jiang Yun's ideas. To prove whether they are correct, it will take several more experiments.
However, with his current status, it is not easy to obtain Taoist items that may contain Taoist meaning, so he can only put the stones aside for the time being and continue to focus on his cultivation.
In the blink of an eye, nine days passed, and Jiang Yun finally stopped his practice again. Listening to the "gurgling" sound in his stomach, he muttered to himself: "Originally, the Bigu Pill can guarantee that you will not be hungry for three days, but after the branding, the time has been extended three times!"
"If you put the Qi-inducing pill into the water, will the amount of spiritual energy it attracts be tripled?"
"In addition, I heard from Senior Brother that there are many elixirs that can be used to improve my cultivation. If they can be put into water, the efficacy of the elixirs can be tripled, which will be of great benefit to my cultivation!"
A flash of light flashed in Jiang Yun's eyes, and it was only at this moment that he finally realized that this stone was of great benefit to his spiritual path, and it was indeed a genuine treasure.
8#4 starting l
"I really don't know how that little girl Yuerou can conclude that this stone is a treasure, but it would be more suitable for her to use such a good thing. Grandpa said that she has good qualifications. When I go back, I will return the stone to her!"
Thinking of Jiang Yuerou, Jiang Yun couldn't help but smile.
In the blink of an eye, it has been more than two months since I left Mangshan, and I have never been separated from her for such a long time. I am afraid that this little girl should be pestering her grandfather now, asking about her whereabouts!
"I miss home too!" Jiang Yun sighed softly and forcibly took back his longing. Instead of missing home here, it would be better to improve his strength quickly so that he can go back early!
"It's just that items containing Taoist meaning are too difficult to find, especially as my handyman disciple, it is impossible to obtain them! Only after becoming an outer disciple, the sect will reward some elixirs and spiritual stones every month, and you can also complete tasks and obtain contribution points, which can be exchanged for various items needed for cultivating the Tao."
This was naturally what Dongfang Bo told Jiang Yun.
Although the sect is a place where countless people want to worship, the resources for cultivation are limited after all, and it is impossible for everyone to enjoy the same treatment, so there are almost strict requirements for the distribution of resources.
Even for the inner disciples, although the sect regularly distributes some items every month, if they want to obtain more resources, they must complete more tasks and obtain contribution points to exchange for them themselves.
And like Jiang YunSuch handyman disciples will only be rewarded once when they successfully join the sect, which is three Bigu Pills and Qi-Entraining Pills, as well as a book of basic exercises.
After that, the sect will no longer care about you and let you fend for yourself. Unless you can continuously improve your cultivation level, continuously improve your own strength, and gradually stand out among the many disciples, only in this way can you get the attention and attention of the sect.
"It seems that the first thing I have to do now is to become an outer disciple! Fortunately, it's almost over!"
Having said this, Jiang Yun showed a confident smile on his face, and at the same time he looked at his body. In his body, five meridians were already flowing smoothly!
In less than half a month, Jiang Yun jumped from a mortal to a monk at the fifth level of Tongmai, and this was the result of his deliberate suppression.
